book.name: Luk
book.title: Luk Dowan Weng Olo Luke Dolanebuotabe.

content: Sakiase weng sangobe.
Yesuse monea Yeliko bib ye helanea unang genabea
monisa nakae niniino Sakiase takis moni bokalin nakai komokobe.
E Yesuse atemang genabe otane e mebweingobe. Nakaia unangai deibo waisasiba e mo atemin blim kene kesoa
e deibe tekein kebe kesoa e sin hebmamsab monea asal daba ut bia
Yesuse ye temte tebianea omut da atemnea nganabanea Sakiaso, kobo hebmamsab daak tele! Memalo ne keb am tam aaunamabibo gesea
wentenea sein seinea daak tenea Yesuse debetnea monea e am uniba
nakaia unangai yatemniba atliaubesoa baaniba Yesuse monea hengmin nakae am tam aaunamabebo ge ohabiba

eka i bebianiba Sakiase deib ye manea Sume baabanea Sum kobo wentene! Memalo ne inamin namino alukum olminia atosino nakaia unangai inamin namin blimi oyenia eka sino ne naka maki dim baabenia monio atosino ayok oiseibuo nakai asuke asuke nai oyenia yang kenamabibo gesea
Yesuse baabanea Niminbabe, naka elesa Eblahame molofeit kesoa Gode nakaia unangai am olo seli memalo hengmino temo blibo dotlanebe.
Abilim Da Tlemin Naka ne tenia nakaia unangai hengmin temo blibi hembiania dotlanang genita tlibiobo ge baabasebe.
Okok nakai i kimanine monio kikibeseo saa wengobe.

Yesuse inangge baasea nakaia unangai wentenabiba saa weng mako baabesebe. Niminbabe, Yesuse tenea Yelusalem bibo kikib ye bia nakaia unangai fumbianiba Memalota Gode kimanamin dimo tam tloa nakaia unangai alukum watemiobo galib kesota e saa weng olo baabenea
Naka make funanea Ne monia bib mak skeim ye motemia kiabwali komok nemfaiba imin tenia nene bib ele okok kebiania ne bibam seli kimanano genea
e okok nakai 10 i nganabene tesiba 20 kina oyen tlanea baabenea Moni olo oloniba inamin namino mo waloniba olabianiba webianiba atosambiba sum anabota tlano ge baabenea deibe unea
ele bibam seli dobsuananiba naka maki dlaiba moniba kiabwali baabeniba Ni naka ele mo moneta ni bibamo kimanamebabo geib otane
kiabwali i wengo ombiabeniba dofaiba komok ambinea sinanoa imin tenea bibam seli baabenea Sino ne okok nakai monio oyen unibiobo nganabeiba i blofet monio olib biamo oleb tliba watemano gesea
nganabesiba naka make tenea baabanea Sum kobo keb K20 o onen unebbuo webiania blofet monio K200 olibiobo gesea
komok sume e okok naka ele seinha bianea baabanea Kobo okok naka ayamobo, monio gwabo kla kima bieb kesoa memalo komok kemfaia bibo 10 olo kimanamabeobo ge baabanabea
mak esak tenea baabanea Sum keb K20 o webiania blofet monio K100 olibiobo gesea
komoke baabanea Kobole kemfaia bibo asuke asuke make na olo kimanamabeobo ge baabanabea
eka mak ele tenea baabanea Sum keb K20 olonia baus tem daak olakania kima blibe. Sma ele biobe.

Niminbabe, ne tekein kebibe, kobo naka dleb kesoa naka maki inamin namino klabibio doise tlebianeba eka imen dang osa dolmaib biamo imeno weleise tlebiam binabeb kesoa ne keb tolo tosianania keb monio sma ele olaibua oleb tlibo gesea

komok sume baabanea Kobo okok naka misiamobo, kleb weng ota kot kebkenobe. Bainobe neko ye naka dleb biania naka maki inamin namino dlaib biamo doise wembiania eka naka maki imen dango dolmaib biamo weleise wembiam binabibe.
Kobo olo tekein kebeb otane nimin kenebta ne monio moni bumin am temo mo olaim blime? Kobo moni bumin am temo olanebbiota mole o okok kebua blofet monio tlak unebota tenita olibo genea
e naka maki meb ye mablibi baabenea E K20 o oisaniba nakae K200 oleb bie naka eta olaline gesea
i baabaniba Kobo naka ele K200 o bibabiobo ge baasiba

komoke baabenea Ne wengo wentine! Ne nakae okoko oman temia e okok olo kla okok keme mole ne naka ele seinha biania e okoko imin mesein kenia omalamabibe. Eka ne nakae okoko gwab oman temia e okok olo mo okok kemin blim kene mole omeisanamabibo ge baabenea
eka imin baabenea Ne wasi nakai kiabwali baabeniba Ne mo komok anamene ge baatnenibbio nakai dleb teniba nene kin dim ele yenaiba kaaine ge baabenebiobo ge baabesebe.
Yesuse komok sumi ulab anea Yelusalem bib onsebe.
Yesuse wengo oyebea blimanoa deibenea Yelusalem bib unang genea
e sin monea bibo niniino Betfasi bib osa eka Betani bib osa o tletle ye amgolime Olibe tabab ye unanea e okok aleyemin nakai asuei baabenea
Ib dabo metniba bib meto temibta til dongki mene bib ye dobginibbua biebo, nakai sino e dimo mo tounibta debeb haanin blimobo ibo atemaibo hebmamsab tileisaniba debeb tline!
Eka naka maka ye bianiba baabeniba Fatnanibta debeb unom genibte? ge baabeib mole ibo baabeniba Sume okoksa kesota dlane tenobta debeb unom genobtabo ge baabenibta debeb tline ge baabenea
dlanea moniba ele baabenebio inaniba
talo tileisa dobonabiba e goseli baabeibo Ibo fatnanibta debeb unom genibte? gesiba
eka asu dabi baabeniba Sume okoksa kesota dlane tenobta debeb unom genobtabo ge baabeniba
debeb tatniba Yesus esu tab teniba i youmo tibo gemeloniba til dongki mene dim ut dongananiba Yesuse daabaiba utnea
til dongki mene dim ut tounea debeb bebea nakaia unangai funaniba Yesuse komok sumobo geib kesoa youmo deib deib ye toum unibbua

e tenea amgolime Olibe golim ut tlanea amgolime deibanea delab mabianiba Yelusalem bibo kikib meb tlib kesoa e okok aleyemin nakai e inamin namin okok sumo klanea watemibbuo i funaniba seimbianiba Gode niniino dobtouleb bebianiba
ngambianiba Komok Sum ele Sume niniin dim ota tlebo, Gode daabaneko! Gode nibo seinyebebo, nibo e niniino dobtouleb nomo ge ngan nganiba bebiba
eka Felisiei maki nakaia unangai isak daak bianiba Yesuse baabaniba Aleyemin naka kobo keb okok aleyemin nakai deine ge baabenale ge baabasiba
e baabenea I kimik geib mole Gode tomo weng omulea ngambianoa ne niniino nemtouleb namabobo ge baabesebe.
Yesuse Yelusalem bib seli melabesebe.
Yesuse inanea monea Yelusalem bibo watemnea nakaia unangai meye bianea
baabenea Mema dim olo ibo inamin namino bobol ayam omyamabo tekein kenimibo ayam otane inamin namin olo ayok bio kesoa ibo mo watemnibta tekein kenomabibbabe.
Ibo wentine! Sinanomo ib wasi nakai yenanomo geniba teniba deib unemino alukum ge waiseniba kan moniba

ibsa ib alelwal isa ib meme isa yafuniba yenaniba bibamo inamin namin osa alukum watwat dabe tlanomabiobe. Niminbabe, ne tenia deib ayame alebei otane ibo ne bobolo mo funaim blim kesota nabenomabiobo ge baabesebe.
Yesuse nakai Gode am sumo tem tamo inamin namino webibo fotebesebe.
Omito Yesuse tanea Gode am sumo daam tem tam unanea temea nakai inamin namino dleb teniba naka maki webianiba monio bokabib kesoa yatemnea fotebenea
baabenea Gode e buk temo baanea Ne am sum ole ne nganemin amobo genebu otane ibo am olo misiam omkabiba o makob ayok henin nakai amo ulab anobo ge baabesebe.

Yesuse inanea ye bianea am obba ye bomanomo bomanomo yo dimo nakaia unangai Gode am sumo tem tam aleyebea Gode amo kimanin nakai komok isa eka hekmel weng tekein kemin naka isa eka besa komokwal afet isa baaniba Ananoba kaaneko gabib otane
nakaia unangai e wengo sbal maniba wentemib kesoa komokwali nakaia unangai tolo tosiananiba e mo anaim blim deiba bisiobe.
